description: Count eligible campaign recipients for an audience. The count reflects current consent and suppression records. Audiences: {"kind":"all"} for every subscriber; {"kind":"tag","tag":KEY} for one tag; {"kind":"segment","match":"any"|"all","tags":[KEY...],"exclude":[KEY...],"lastVisit"?:{"when":"within"|"over","days":N},"services"?:[SERVICE_ID...]} to combine tags (anyone with any, or all, of tags, minus anyone with an exclude tag) and visits (as save_email_segment describes); {"kind":"saved_segment","id":ID} for a segment from list_email_segments; {"kind":"unopened","runId":ID} for people a sent campaign reached who haven't opened it; {"kind":"inactive"} for people who ignored their last 5 campaigns, whom every other audience leaves out (inactiveLeftOut counts them), for one "still want these emails?" campaign. Tag keys are the key values from list_contact_tag_options. limit is the most one campaign can reach for this business now.
name: preview_email_audience
